summary: Closed T53's four findings against the auto-fetch floor (src/security/detect/exfil.ts, src/security/detect/exfil.test.ts only). All four reproduced against the current tree before acting. F-001 (minor): base branch comment and a dedicated remediation string now disclose that a masked re-points the whole document, not one image (T52's asymmetry); and a base finding is now suppressed when the tag sits inside a CLOSED HTML comment or CommonMark fenced code block, bounded so an unterminated delimiter is left eager rather than suppressed, base-only (img/image unchanged). F-002 (info, most consequential): rewrote the two-base sufficiency argument to name resolvedHost's http(s) filter as the fact that actually closes the FILE-state and opaque-path branches, and states that widening resolvedHost invalidates the argument; comment only, two new regression tests pin the fact directly. F-003 (info): readStartTag's doc comment now states both the eager (unterminated tag) and conservative (unterminated quoted value swallows the rest of the fragment) halves of EOF handling; comment only, one new regression test pins the conservative half in this file's own suite. F-004 (info): recorded, as a named decision rather than an incidental lastIndex side effect, that markup inside a quoted attribute value is released unmasked because it is text under any conformant HTML parser; behaviour kept, not reversed, per the dispatch. Every reviewer probe (T53-extract/-resolve/-base/-boundary/-corpus, T42-exfil-attack, T24-recheck2-exfil, T42-charrefs, T42-boundary, T24-recheck2-boundary) re-run unmodified: all matrices byte-identical to T53's recorded numbers except T53-base.ts and T53-corpus.ts, which show the intended, measured improvement (g07/g08 and codeFenceBaseExample no longer flagged; 0/15 hostile still neutralized, unchanged). 87 pass / 0 fail / 629 expect() on the four required focused suites (36/0/331 on exfil.test.ts alone, including 12 new tests). typecheck and eslint clean on both changed files. A RED-before/GREEN-after probe (temporary in-file inversion of the new guard, restored to a byte-identical file) confirmed 3 of the 12 new tests fail without the fix.

findings.problem: The class did not disclose that a false positive is a whole-document effect (unlike 's one-image cost), and inherited the extractor's non-element-context over-approximation for comment/fenced-code content, which the corpus could not exercise because the repository contains no benign at all.
findings.impact: No bypass; the direction was toward over-flagging. A benign <base href> quoted in documentation (a markdown fence or an HTML comment) was masked, silently changing every relative URL's resolution in that document.
findings.suggested_fix: State the whole-document effect in the branch's comment and remediation string; decide whether the class should still fire inside a span no renderer parses as markup.

findings.suggested_fix: State the two-part reason: scheme-equality coverage from the pairs, plus resolvedHost's protocol filter closing the FILE/opaque-path branches; name the widening consequence.
